Agent Skills are copied to .github/skills, where Copilot discovers them project-wide and activates them on demand; the catalog is not private to this agent.

Plugin skills are copied to .github/skills. MCP servers are emitted twice: in the agent file for the cloud coding agent, where they are per agent, and in .vscode/mcp.json for VS Code, where they are workspace wide.

The agents list names the subagents; each runs as a bounded task through the task tool and returns its result to the caller. Copilot CLI advertises and runs every custom agent in the project regardless of the list (probe evidence), so the list is not an enforced allowlist there.
